sp:black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein.why: 提供開發者直接體驗最新開源圖像生成技術的效能與細節

pa:2610.18762.name: Looking Complete Is Not Being Grounded: Evaluating LLM Sitreps Against Human-Authored Situation Reports
pa:2610.18762.desc: LLM-generated crisis reports match human performance on some metrics but fail to supply professional provenance and reproduce few official figures, while common automatic scores poorly reflect completeness.

pa:2610.17242.name: When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen
pa:2610.17242.desc: CameraVLM improves vision-language model understanding of camera motion by jointly learning off-screen motion states and on-screen flow dynamics with language-aligned training.

pa:2610.18755.name: PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards
pa:2610.18755.desc: PreciseCoder improves code repair by rewarding precise, localized edits rather than only unit-test passage, reducing unnecessary changes and improving generalization across model sizes.

pa:2610.15112.name: Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
pa:2610.15112.desc: Drive3R is a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model that enables scalable, long-horizon multi-view 3D reconstruction for autonomous driving by using block-wise causal attention and confidence-aware re-anchoring to reduce drift and maintain global consistency.

pa:2610.14162.name: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
pa:2610.14162.desc: Next-Concept Modeling uses hierarchical discrete codes and parallel level-wise generation to accelerate diffusion language models while improving quality and reasoning performance.

pa:2610.14216.name: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
pa:2610.14216.desc: Cortex validates agent harness updates by replaying developer corrections, retaining only rules and skills that consistently improve performance without degrading tasks.

pa:2610.15715.name: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
pa:2610.15715.desc: NoteBank augments linear attention models with a sparse episodic memory that stores selected text and replays it through native computation, greatly improving long-context retrieval without extra training or significant overhead.
pa:2610.15715.org: KAUST Center of Excellence in Generative AI

pa:2610.17301.name: The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow
pa:2610.17301.desc: Residual-stream forecasting detects unauthorized agent actions and false reports before they occur, enabling low-cost gating that reduces violations and prompt-injection attacks without harming task completion.

pa:2610.13623.name: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
pa:2610.13623.desc: APEX-Harm evaluates long-horizon agent vulnerabilities to injection attacks across large multi-tool workspaces, revealing high success rates for script-based attacks despite correct task outputs.
pa:2610.13623.org: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

pa:2610.19128.name: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
pa:2610.19128.desc: CLASHarness introduces a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer-use tasks, revealing that frontier vision-language models struggle with verifying ground truth, resolving conflicts, and coordinating shared resources.

pa:2610.19628.name: Self-Conditioning Enables Deep Sequential Reasoning in Flow Matching
pa:2610.19628.desc: Flow matching with self-conditioning enables deeper visual reasoning by allowing iterative sampling steps to increase expressive power beyond constant-depth limits.

pa:2610.19361.name: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
pa:2610.19361.desc: A vision-language waypoint policy using staged multimodal training improves robot tracking of intended people among distractors and benefits from on-policy refinement.

pa:2610.19729.name: A Diagnostic Study of World-Space Human Recovery Under High Camera Dynamics
pa:2610.19729.desc: A scale mismatch between independently recovered camera and human estimates causes severe world-space drift in fast-motion dance videos, which is corrected by a closed-form rescaling method that stabilizes multi-person reconstruction without retraining.

pa:2610.18354.name: Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions
pa:2610.18354.desc: Strategic model selection for game-theoretic LLM evaluation reveals that multi-armed bandit methods outperform embedding-based selectors but remain below fixed-model baselines against adaptive opponents.

pa:2610.19420.name: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
pa:2610.19420.desc: WEDGE guides environment generation for embodied navigation agents by diagnosing policy failure modes and constructing targeted training scenarios that address specific weaknesses.
pa:2610.19420.org: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

pa:2610.14020.name: LabInstruct: Benchmarking Situated Instructional Video Generation for Lab Procedures
pa:2610.14020.desc: LabInstruct evaluates AI-generated instructional videos for real laboratory tasks and reveals that visual plausibility does not ensure procedural correctness.

pa:2610.20588.name: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
pa:2610.20588.desc: The method converts pre-trained transformers into elastic models that adapt continuously to varying computational budgets by jointly ranking and softly pruning individual neurons and attention heads across multiple sparsity targets without retraining.

pa:2610.20516.name: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
pa:2610.20516.desc: Value-Augmented Self-Distillation Policy Optimization integrates a self-teacher and critic within PPO to improve reasoning by combining token-level advantages with bounded probability ratios, boosting accuracy on mathematical benchmarks.
pa:2610.20516.org: University of Science and Technology of China

pa:2610.18638.name: To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train
pa:2610.18638.desc: COMPASS estimates model-pair compatibility before alignment or merging by measuring local neighborhood overlap and paradigm limits, guiding resource allocation across cross-modal and merging tasks.

pa:2610.18598.name: Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs
pa:2610.18598.desc: PORTAL initializes multimodal projectors without paired data by aligning vision and language feature distributions via optimal transport, matching standard training performance while eliminating projector training.

pa:2610.14270.name: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
pa:2610.14270.desc: Reinforcement learning gains in hybrid reasoning models' NO-THINK mode largely stem from reactivating existing THINK-mode reasoning rather than learning new capabilities.
pa:2610.14270.org: KAUST Center of Excellence in Generative AI

pa:2610.17309.name: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
pa:2610.17309.desc: StartLux-Decision introduces efficient and adaptive decision models using single-pass prediction and confidence-guided reasoning, trained via a three-stage pipeline with RLCD² reinforcement learning, and evaluates them on Decision Index and the DecisionPivot benchmark.

pa:2610.17079.name: Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?
pa:2610.17079.desc: Shallow late fusion of LLM-generated reasoning guidance outperforms deep attention injection in knowledge-based VQA under limited data, highlighting that integration depth should align with the training regime.

pa:2610.20137.name: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
pa:2610.20137.desc: StreamErase enables real-time, streaming video object removal with sub-second latency by transferring erasing capabilities from a bidirectional model to an efficient unidirectional streaming generator using sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks.

pa:2610.17246.name: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
pa:2610.17246.desc: LLM-to-Flow Distillation aligns scientific generators with high-level discovery goals by using a frozen LLM to build adaptive curricula and distill preferences via DPO, enabling control over peptide and small-molecule design.

pa:2610.20220.name: Glance Forcing: Making Bidirectional Diffusion Autoregressive at a Glance
pa:2610.20220.desc: Glance Forcing improves video generation efficiency by splitting denoising into specialized experts guided by stage-specific objectives, reducing training costs while improving quality.

pa:2610.20431.name: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
pa:2610.20431.desc: SwarmRSI evolves scientific agent swarms through feedback-guided mutation and complementary recombination to enable recursive self-improvement across research tasks.

pa:2610.19422.name: AgentSafeEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
pa:2610.19422.desc: AgentSafeEvo uses adversarial co-evolution to train LLM agents to resist malicious tool-use attacks across diverse tasks without sacrificing general capabilities.

pa:2610.05230.name: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
pa:2610.05230.desc: Vela is a vision-language-action model that uses continuous spline-based trajectories to adapt temporal resolution for robot manipulation, improving long-horizon planning and local precision.

pa:2610.19698.name: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
pa:2610.19698.desc: RuleTrek is a multi-domain benchmark that evaluates large language model agents on identifying, deducing, and applying domain-specific rules across complex, multi-file scenarios, revealing substantial performance gaps.

pa:2610.17016.name: ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty
pa:2610.17016.desc: ProbabilityBench supplies exact instance-level class probabilities across simulated text domains to directly evaluate model calibration and benchmark standard metrics against known ground truth.

pa:2610.19026.name: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
pa:2610.19026.desc: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention improves long-context decoding by learning a shared low-dimensional query-key subspace for accurate token selection and using a gather-free kernel, achieving near-full accuracy with substantially higher throughput.

pa:2610.13239.name: Jag: Direct Box Prediction for Efficient Visual Grounding
pa:2610.13239.desc: Jag adapts a compact pretrained multimodal model to predict bounding boxes directly via a regression head, improving grounding accuracy and reducing inference latency.

pa:2610.19726.name: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING
pa:2610.19726.desc: A generative framework couples a persistent shared world state with continuous first-person audiovisual generation to enable sustained interactive experiences that evolve through user actions.

pa:2610.17771.name: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
pa:2610.17771.desc: ReMaRk improves reinforcement learning for recommendation by scoring generated lists against all valid replies jointly, reducing training cost while matching or exceeding prior performance.

pa:2610.19696.name: Share the Symbol, Not the Vector: Training-Free Fact Communication Across Language Models
pa:2610.19696.desc: SYNC enables heterogeneous language models to share selective object facts via word indices and receiver-local hidden-state directions without fine-tuning or translators.

pa:2610.15542.name: Apertus 1.5: From Open Text Models to Open Multimodal Reasoners
pa:2610.15542.desc: Apertus 1.5 extends open multimodal language models to image and audio reasoning with long-context training, reinforcement learning, and fully open data and weights.

pa:2610.14774.name: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
pa:2610.14774.desc: ProgAgent introduces a programmatic tool-calling training framework that improves long-horizon agent performance by using executable code and runtime variables instead of sequential context accumulation.

pa:2610.16338.name: SyncReward: Human-Aligned Synchronization Reward for Audio-Visual Generation
pa:2610.16338.desc: Researchers introduce a dataset, benchmark, and reward model to evaluate and improve synchronization between generated audio and visual content.

pa:2610.18838.name: Scaling Online Optimal Transport Minibatches for Flow Matching
pa:2610.18838.desc: Scalable entropic optimal transport approximations enable larger source-target couplings in flow matching, reducing gradient variance and integration error while improving training stability and generation quality.

pa:2610.20582.name: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
pa:2610.20582.desc: Latent Compaction uses test-time training to learn compact, document-specific key-value caches that preserve retrieval accuracy under aggressive compression without requiring downstream questions.

pa:2610.20399.name: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
pa:2610.20399.desc: Cortex consolidates context-induced improvements into mergeable low-rank or structural updates, preserving non-target capabilities across sequential edits and diverse model scales.

pa:2610.14261.name: BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images
pa:2610.14261.desc: BigCell generates coherent gigapixel-scale histopathology images using flow-matching transformers and adaptive scheduling, enabling text-conditioned synthesis and improving few-shot classification.

pa:2610.04781.name: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
pa:2610.04781.desc: Real-world super-resolution is improved by mapping degraded image embeddings back to a high-resolution manifold within a frozen DINOv3-L latent space, yielding high fidelity and fast inference.

pa:2610.10787.name: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
pa:2610.10787.desc: NavGPT-3 integrates long-horizon reasoning with low-latency action policies via an OS-like runtime, achieving human-level embodied navigation performance.

pa:2610.14096.name: SWEeper-Bench: Can Agents Discover Bugs in Interactive Software?
pa:2610.14096.desc: SWEeper-Bench evaluates coding agents on finding and fixing interaction-dependent bugs in web applications through interactive testing and browser-based verification.

pa:2610.20604.name: VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action
pa:2610.20604.desc: VITAL derives driving actions from visual motion via a coupled motion scaffold and residual tokenizer, enabling fast, accurate trajectory prediction and bounded reinforcement refinement.

pa:2610.20609.name: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
pa:2610.20609.desc: SafeDriveVLA improves autonomous driving by predicting navigation compliance and using world-model dreaming to avoid unsafe instructions, outperforming existing vision-language-action models.

pa:2610.19560.name: τ-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
pa:2610.19560.desc: A benchmark and data pipeline evaluate and improve LLM tool-calling agents under emotionally varied user interactions by filtering ineffective trajectories and scaling supervised training.

pa:2610.15725.name: SkillMarker: A KGW-Based Watermarking Method for Agent Skill Ownership Verification
pa:2610.15725.desc: SkillMarker embeds watermarks into agent skills while preserving instruction accuracy to enable ownership verification and leakage tracing.

pa:2610.19820.name: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
pa:2610.19820.desc: ActionOPD aligns smaller language-model agents with teachers via semantic action-level on-policy distillation, improving out-of-distribution tool-use performance without requiring shared tokenizers or teacher probabilities.

pa:2610.14448.name: KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization
pa:2610.14448.desc: KV4-RL accelerates reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards via INT4 KV cache quantization with selective INT8 protection, achieving substantial speedups with minimal accuracy loss.

pa:2610.09055.name: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking
pa:2610.09055.desc: MimicX improves humanoid motion tracking by using execution feedback to refine video-driven policies, reducing tracking errors and extending robust execution horizons.

pa:2610.19551.name: TextVerifier: Seeing Beyond Recognition to Verify Chinese Text Rendering
pa:2610.19551.desc: A target-conditioned verifier using Ideographic Description Sequences detects local Chinese text rendering errors and improves generation through reinforcement learning.

pa:2610.18284.name: Efficient Scene-Text Refinement via Pixel-Space Grouped Image Generation
pa:2610.18284.desc: PixText refines local text in generated images via grouped pixel-space generation with MeanFlow, improving glyph accuracy while preserving backgrounds and reducing inference cost.

pa:2610.20195.name: What Makes a Social Agent's Interactions Effective? Learning from Verifiable Outcomes in Paired Worlds
pa:2610.20195.desc: HICO-Bench evaluates whether conversational agents produce feasible, verifiable coordination plans, and PaCPO improves success by rewarding turns that yield correct tentative plans across paired scenarios.

pa:2610.17831.name: Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing
pa:2610.17831.desc: Diff Diffusion is a diffusion-based language model framework that predicts structured code edits to enable fast, accurate, low-latency modifications in AI-assisted development environments.

pa:2610.20524.name: Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics
pa:2610.20524.desc: Temporal Flow Policy integrates measured time intervals into robot memory dynamics to improve action timing and retention of past events across physical time.

pa:2610.18861.name: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
pa:2610.18861.desc: Hybrid Reasoning Agents combine latent internal reasoning with text-based external interaction via a unified architecture and specialized post-training, improving agent performance while reducing inference cost and token usage.

pa:2610.20584.name: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
pa:2610.20584.desc: Player-1 improves game control by combining supervised fine-tuning on gameplay trajectories with reinforcement learning across synthetic environments, achieving substantial gains over demonstration-only baselines.
pa:2610.20584.zh: 結合遊戲紀錄與模擬環境來精進操作技巧
pa:2610.20584.why: 讓AI透過大量模擬與遊戲示範學習，大幅提升遊戲控制能力

pa:2606.24472.name: G^3VLA: Geometric Inductive Bias for Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2606.24472.desc: G³VLA injects calibrated multi-camera geometry into vision-language-action models via ray embeddings and cross-view fusion, improving robot manipulation without changing the action space.

pa:2610.19525.name: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
pa:2610.19525.desc: CALIF combines verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood bonus to prevent reward hacking and maintain response quality during reinforcement learning on instruction-following benchmarks.

pa:2610.20344.name: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
pa:2610.20344.desc: Doc2Harness is a deterministic two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering by having models build and run harnesses across isolated containers, revealing substantial performance gaps among frontier models.
pa:2610.20344.zh: 評估程式碼代理處理長期工程任務的能力
pa:2610.20344.why: 透過隔離容器實際建構與測試，點出目前頂尖模型在長天期寫程式上的表現落差

pa:2610.18248.name: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
pa:2610.18248.desc: This survey organizes benchmark compression methods for large language models into a taxonomy covering subset selection, cross-suite recovery, and adaptive evaluation to reduce evaluation costs while maintaining reliability.

pa:2610.20442.name: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
pa:2610.20442.desc: This survey unifies research on agentic robots by tracing the evolution from robot policies to integrated systems using vision-language-action models, world models, and structured functional domains.

pa:2610.19789.name: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.19789.desc: Researchers benchmarked ten self-distillation methods against GRPO across multiple agent tasks and model sizes, finding limited consistent gains, hidden training instability, and no reliable cost-to-performance benefit.
pa:2610.19789.zh: 檢視AI代理自我學習方法的實際成效
pa:2610.19789.why: 實測多種自我學習方法後發現效果有限且隱藏風險，為業界提供客觀評估

pa:2610.20256.name: Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon
pa:2610.20256.desc: A single-rollout asynchronous training recipe combining Muon optimization, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary penalties improves long-horizon agent success on repository-level issue resolution.

pa:2610.19366.name: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
pa:2610.19366.desc: This work proposes a two-axis framework for multimodal agent memory covering information formation and adaptive management to support lifelong learning.

pa:2610.19138.name: MA-Bench: Measuring Operational Planning in Language Models
pa:2610.19138.desc: MA-Bench evaluates language models on synthesizing contradictory military planning documents into structured briefs, finding that even top models achieve only 62% of expert rubric requirements with inference and omission errors being common.

pa:2610.13521.name: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
pa:2610.13521.desc: Road MOPD reduces gradient conflicts in multi-teacher distillation by using cross-teacher agreement for token-level credit assignment and auxiliary gradients to constrain conflicting updates.
pa:2610.13521.zh: 改善多個AI老師同時指導時的衝突問題
pa:2610.13521.why: 協調不同老師的意見來引導學習，避免AI被互相矛盾的指令搞混

pa:2610.20572.name: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
pa:2610.20572.desc: CriticOPD improves on-policy distillation by using teacher critiques to restore recoverability, enabling students to revise incorrect reasoning and achieve stronger mathematical reasoning performance.
pa:2610.20572.zh: 利用老師的評論修正AI學生的推理過程
pa:2610.20572.why: 幫助AI在學習時修正錯誤的邏輯推導，顯著提升數學與邏輯推理能力

pa:2610.02089.name: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
pa:2610.02089.desc: HumanoidToolBench evaluates humanoid robots on tool selection and coordinated manipulation and locomotion across diverse tasks, revealing gaps between selection and execution.

pa:2610.17638.name: Acting Through Registers
pa:2610.17638.desc: RegisterWAM reorganizes visual representations via learnable registers and flow-matching supervision to suppress spatial outliers and improve robot action learning.

pa:2610.20456.name: The COUNT: Counting N-grams Unlocks Scaling on Host Memory and Training-Free Adaptation
pa:2610.20456.desc: COUNT improves language model efficiency by using precomputed n-gram counts stored in host memory to augment embeddings without learned parameters, boosting performance and enabling domain adaptation at inference.

pa:2610.20571.name: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
pa:2610.20571.desc: ATAS improves long-form video consistency by compiling screenplays into referenced shot requests, retrieving spatial and temporal evidence from scene and event memories, and conditionally updating memory after generation.
pa:2610.20571.zh: 讓AI自動生成前後一致的長影片
pa:2610.20571.why: 透過劇本拆解與記憶更新機制，解決長影片容易畫面錯亂的問題

pa:2610.15425.name: Exploring the Limits of Combinatorial Generalization in Embodied Manipulation
pa:2610.15425.desc: Hierarchical Subtask Execution and Pose Robust Task Initialization improve skill recombination in long-horizon robot manipulation by closing start-state gaps at subtask transitions.

pa:2610.19118.name: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
pa:2610.19118.desc: DecisionRobust evaluates decision model reliability against adversarial text, image, and prompt injection attacks, showing that robustness varies by task and that label consistency checks reduce apparent attack success.

pa:2610.19975.name: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
pa:2610.19975.desc: LatentLoop improves looped Mixture-of-Experts by compressing the first loop visit, reallocating saved computation to larger hidden dimensions, and using separate attention parameters, yielding lower validation loss and better benchmark scores.
pa:2610.19975.zh: 透過不對稱運算分配來擴展混合專家模型
pa:2610.19975.why: 重新分配運算資源並放大隱藏維度，讓模型在減少損耗的同時獲得更好的跑分

pa:2610.18097.name: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
pa:2610.18097.desc: APT is an automated framework that adaptively post-trains text-to-image models by using agents to evaluate capabilities, diagnose failures, and generate targeted reinforcement learning data in a self-improving loop.

pa:2610.19100.name: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.19100.desc: ScreenRef provides multimodal GUI grounding annotations across desktop, web, and mobile environments, and the D2RL training approach improves model generalization to achieve state-of-the-art results among 8B-scale agents.

pa:2610.20586.name: Continuum Attention
pa:2610.20586.desc: Continuum Attention replaces discrete key-value lookup with continuous integration over a piecewise linear memory curve, improving language modeling performance while preserving standard Transformer architecture.

pa:2610.18072.name: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
pa:2610.18072.desc: LensErase is a mask-based erasure foundation model pretrained on a large paired dataset and refined with reinforcement learning to handle diverse real-world removal tasks while preserving surrounding content.

pa:2610.16302.name: RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models
pa:2610.16302.desc: Rate-Adaptive Rollout enables interactive world models to generate video at variable temporal rates with consistent dynamics and extended physical horizons.

pa:2610.17893.name: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
pa:2610.17893.desc: CoSIR trains LLM agents to collaborate by rewarding information sharing and usage via surprisal reduction, improving multi-agent performance on unseen tasks.

pa:2610.16117.name: Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues
pa:2610.16117.desc: UnCoBench evaluates multi-agent collaboration under unreliable colleagues by testing verification, gap diagnosis, and dependency tracking to recover flawed evidence gathering.

pa:2610.18472.name: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
pa:2610.18472.desc: Simplified Matching Distillation enables efficient few-step generation across images, video, 3D, and audio using pure velocity regression with a residual proxy and weak-teacher repulsion, scaling to 33 billion parameters.

pa:2610.18677.name: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
pa:2610.18677.desc: Generative Trajectory Planning learns a diffusion-based proposal distribution over action sequences to enable efficient long-horizon reasoning by sampling and refining candidates with learned dynamics and value models.

pa:2610.02638.name: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
pa:2610.02638.desc: DuplexJev enables rapid full-duplex voice decision-making by feeding ASR encoder states into a frozen LLM via connectors, achieving high accuracy for spoken QA and speaker attributes without autoregressive decoding.

pa:2610.18497.name: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
pa:2610.18497.desc: Judges evaluating LLM agent arguments exhibit a derivation gap when correct values lack visible references, which is mitigated by a separate DeRef model that writes explicit references to improve evaluation accuracy.

pa:2610.14530.name: Who to Trust in Multi-Robot Systems: Joint Robot and Object Hypothesis Trust Inference via Neural-Symbolic Cross-Validation
pa:2610.14530.desc: NeST-Bayes is a neural-symbolic framework that jointly infers robot and hypothesis trust from inter-robot observation consistency using relational graphs and Bayesian updates, improving reliability under adversarial and occluded conditions.

pa:2610.04906.name: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
pa:2610.04906.desc: WorkForge synthesizes verifiable, real-world work environments for long-horizon agents by deriving tasks and verifiers from observable workspace evidence, significantly improving agent performance across professional domains.

pa:2610.14091.name: Pristine Models
pa:2610.14091.desc: Pristine Models compartmentalize safe and unsafe knowledge into separate branches during pretraining, allowing unsafe parameters to be detached at inference to improve safety without sacrificing image quality.

pa:2607.08809.name: Privacy-Preserving Intent Fulfilment and Assurance for 6G RAN
pa:2607.08809.desc: The architecture provisions 6G resources from declared intent categories without traffic inspection and verifies fulfillment using only standardized cell-level performance counters, providing formal privacy bounds and practical verification across operator networks.

pa:2610.16759.name: Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images
pa:2610.16759.desc: InterpTok improves image tokenizers by training decoders on interpolated codes between training samples, yielding sharper generations and faster convergence.

pa:2610.18760.name: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
pa:2610.18760.desc: ARBITER is a reinforcement-learning-trained mixture-of-experts verifier that diagnoses programming errors with generated counterexamples, improving test-time selection and refinement of code solutions.

pa:2610.15228.name: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
pa:2610.15228.desc: A benchmark evaluates large language models in real-world closed-loop control of robotic and sensor systems, measuring grounded perception, planning, and adaptive correction.

pa:2610.18596.name: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
pa:2610.18596.desc: ACCRUE is a continual off-policy reinforcement learning framework that preserves prior robot behaviors and accelerates new task learning by carrying lightweight actor and critic networks across stages.

pa:2610.18738.name: Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization
pa:2610.18738.desc: Proximal KL improves off-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by using token-wise importance weighting and bounded future KL credit, achieving higher accuracy and stability than existing methods.

pa:2610.18579.name: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
pa:2610.18579.desc: Fast agent models frequently choose wrong actions despite correctly reading the state, with errors clustering on specific states and persisting even when all relevant facts are known, indicating failures in reasoning and sub-goal formation rather than perception.

pa:2610.18614.name: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
pa:2610.18614.desc: Calibrating an LLM agent's step-level confidence against final episode outcomes improves failure prediction and selective execution across multi-step environments.

pa:2610.18773.name: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
pa:2610.18773.desc: Jeva is a decision-native architecture that jointly enforces null-awareness, permutation invariance, option scalability, and cross-request caching for structured decision-making.
pa:2610.18773.zh: 為結構化決策打造的基礎模型架構
pa:2610.18773.why: 整合多項核心運算設計，讓AI能更快速且準確地做出複雜決策

pa:2610.18615.name: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
pa:2610.18615.desc: VideoJev converts video observations into structured decisions by scoring temporal intervals and text options, enabling efficient reusable inference for visual agents.
pa:2610.18615.zh: 將影片內容轉化為結構化決策的視覺模型
pa:2610.18615.why: 能精準分析影片時間點與文字選項，幫助AI視覺助理更有效率地執行任務

pa:2610.18356.name: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
pa:2610.18356.desc: Urbex reframes city-scale 3D grounding as an active search process using a vision-language agent with reinforcement learning, improving accuracy and speed without precomputed proposals.
pa:2610.18356.zh: 讓AI在大型3D城市中像真人一樣主動探索
pa:2610.18356.why: 結合視覺語言與強化學習，不用預先標註就能在龐大城市場景中快速定位

pa:2610.18868.name: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
pa:2610.18868.desc: Tev-Gym provides verified long-horizon training environments with dense progressive rewards, and progress-potential reward shaping enables efficient training of Tev-27B, which achieves competitive long-horizon agent performance.
pa:2610.18868.zh: 提供豐富進度獎勵的長期任務訓練環境
pa:2610.18868.why: 透過細膩的進度回饋，有效訓練出能處理複雜長期任務的高效AI

pa:2610.14224.name: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
pa:2610.14224.desc: Harness² improves agent execution harnesses through recursive task-level refinement and continual harness-level learning, boosting performance across benchmarks without ground-truth verifiers.
pa:2610.14224.zh: 透過自我遞迴持續精進AI代理的執行能力
pa:2610.14224.why: 在沒有標準答案的狀況下，讓AI透過自我修正與反覆學習來提升表現

pa:2610.18774.name: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
pa:2610.18774.desc: GreenWAM is a unified world foundation model for robotics that uses a shared anatomical action space and joint training to serve as both a predictive world model and a control policy across diverse robot bodies.
pa:2610.18774.zh: 能同時預測世界並控制各種機器的通用機器人模型
pa:2610.18774.why: 用統一的身體動作空間與聯合訓練，讓同一個模型能驅動各式各樣的機器人

pa:2610.16794.name: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
pa:2610.16794.desc: Tracking-Value PPO improves reinforcement learning for reasoning by modeling value evolution through cumulative log-odds updates, yielding better accuracy and generalization.
pa:2610.16794.zh: 用來提升語言模型推理能力的強化學習方法
pa:2610.16794.why: 透過追蹤數值變化來改善學習過程，讓AI的邏輯推理更準確、更全面

pa:2610.18067.name: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
pa:2610.18067.desc: WorkRover enables iterative refinement of interactive training environments for long-horizon agents via recursive synthesis, compatibility replay, and turn-level credit assignment.
pa:2610.18067.zh: 透過環境自我演化來訓練長期合作型AI代理
pa:2610.18067.why: 不斷自動優化訓練環境與任務分配，大幅提升AI處理長期複雜工作的能力

pa:2610.14709.name: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
pa:2610.14709.desc: Vela converts real-world user behavior records into training tasks and trajectories, improving large language model performance on user-related and general benchmarks through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
pa:2610.14709.zh: 用真實用戶行為來激發大型語言模型的智慧
pa:2610.14709.why: 把實際使用紀錄變成訓練教材，讓AI在日常應用與通用表現上都更聰明

pa:2610.13990.name: DoSA: Dots Sparse Attention
pa:2610.13990.desc: DoSA accelerates sparse attention by using a certificate to conditionally score only eligible tokens, preserving exact selection while reducing computation.
pa:2610.13990.zh: 只計算關鍵內容的極速稀疏注意力機制
pa:2610.13990.why: 透過條件篩選精準挑出重要資訊，在完全不失準的情況下大幅省下運算資源

pa:2610.16811.name: X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning
pa:2610.16811.desc: X-Ragent improves chest X-ray diagnosis by selectively seeking auxiliary evidence and filtering invalid measurements through reinforcement learning.
pa:2610.16811.zh: 結合工具與強化學習來解讀X光片的AI系統
pa:2610.16811.why: 讓AI學會主動尋找輔助證據並過濾錯誤數據，提升胸部X光診斷的準確度

pa:2610.15166.name: ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling
pa:2610.15166.desc: ExeWorldBench evaluates executable world modeling by assessing both structural understanding and code-based 3D construction across mechanism, compositional, and intent-driven tasks.
pa:2610.15166.org: University of Science and Technology of China
pa:2610.15166.zh: 評估用程式碼建立3D世界模型的效能
pa:2610.15166.why: 透過結構理解與程式碼建構測試，全面檢驗AI生成3D場景與機制的真實能力

pa:2610.12818.name: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
pa:2610.12818.desc: LeWAM is an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture that jointly learns latent dynamics and action flow matching for efficient planning and direct control.
pa:2610.12818.zh: 能同時預測環境與動作的端到端世界模型
pa:2610.12818.why: 同時學習動態環境與動作協調，讓AI能更有效率地進行計畫與直接控制

pa:2610.15028.name: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training
pa:2610.15028.desc: UltraBERT improves bidirectional encoder performance by optimizing masking ratios, compute allocation, and distillation to achieve state-of-the-art results on both classification and retrieval benchmarks.

pa:2610.17201.name: Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication
pa:2610.17201.desc: Multics introduces hierarchical group-level communication and dynamic grouping to scale multi-player world models efficiently while reducing interference and maintaining consistency.

pa:2610.17953.name: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
pa:2610.17953.desc: Agent-Reflex trains interactive agents to reflect and recover from noisy tool feedback and user corrections through skill discovery, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy optimization.
pa:2610.17953.zh: 教導AI助理自我反省以修正錯誤指令
pa:2610.17953.why: 讓AI在面對工具出錯或使用者修正時懂得自我檢討，大幅提升互動的準確度

pa:2610.17227.name: AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
pa:2610.17227.desc: AReA improves high-resolution image generation with diffusion transformers by adapting attention from global to local across denoising steps without extra training.

pa:2610.01496.name: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
pa:2610.01496.desc: SALD is a self-referenced training framework for diffusion models that uses dual noise-level evaluation and adaptive weighting to improve generation quality without external teachers or extra parameters.

pa:2610.14609.name: EviScene: Beyond "Is It AI?" for Agentic Image Factuality Assessment
pa:2610.14609.desc: The study introduces a benchmark and multimodal agent for assessing whether depicted image situations are factually supported through iterative evidence retrieval and analysis.

pa:2609.38847.name: Scoring Higher, Answering Worse: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based RL via Protocol-Level Rubrics
pa:2609.38847.desc: ProRubric improves rubric-based reinforcement learning by grouping criteria into protocol-level dimensions that require all conditions to hold, preventing compensation and improving answer quality.

pa:2610.12843.name: APEX: Asynchronous Prefix Denoising for Extreme Compression
pa:2610.12843.desc: APEX uses hierarchical latent spaces and asynchronous denoising over channel groups to achieve extreme image compression with high generation quality at low compute.

pa:2610.17928.name: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
pa:2610.17928.desc: SwitchMem dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each interaction step for vision-language GUI agents, improving performance over fixed-modality approaches.

pa:2610.11850.name: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
pa:2610.11850.desc: VEDJE enables efficient video retrieval by compressing frame features into a reusable cache and using feature-change prediction to maintain accuracy without increasing query-time cost.

pa:2610.18860.name: AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards
pa:2610.18860.desc: AesCode improves code generation for visual artifacts by combining design graphs with cross-modal rewards guided by reference images, enhancing layout, aesthetics, and verifiable correctness.

pa:2610.17552.name: FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching
pa:2610.17552.desc: FlashVSR+ improves video super-resolution efficiency and preference alignment via hybrid attention and reward-weighted distribution matching distillation.

pa:2610.17666.name: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
pa:2610.17666.desc: DeltaTTG learns a reusable progress signal via token-to-go estimates to redistribute advantages across steps in multi-turn reinforcement learning, improving scores and efficiency without extra task rules.

pa:2610.16354.name: Self-Distillation with Verbal Regularization
pa:2610.16354.desc: Self-distillation with verbal regularization improves reasoning by using system prompts to reduce shortcut bias from privileged information, preserving output diversity and boosting accuracy.

pa:2610.15782.name: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
pa:2610.15782.desc: RSI-Nav improves vision-language navigation by recursively generating and filtering instruction-action pairs with a shared model that updates continuously on trajectory shards, boosting navigation success and instruction quality.

pa:2610.18871.name: Cepheid: Decoupling Scale from Structure for Cross-Family Motion Completion
pa:2610.18871.desc: A dimensionless residual prior with estimated amplitude enables robust sparse-to-dense motion completion across diverse geometry families without cross-mesh correspondence.
pa:2610.18871.org: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

pa:2610.15765.name: A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution
pa:2610.15765.desc: Researchers benchmark desktop software interfaces for AI agents, identifying discoverability, granularity, and observability as key properties, and propose ANIS to synthesize agent-native interfaces that improve task success and reduce token usage.

pa:2610.18568.name: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
pa:2610.18568.desc: WAVE-0 integrates a lightweight latent world model with pretrained vision-language-action policies to guide robotic manipulation via predicted future consequences, achieving high success rates without video pretraining or pixel reconstruction.

pa:2610.14118.name: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
pa:2610.14118.desc: ClawLoop is a self-improving framework for harness-based LLM agents that cycles task synthesis, training, and behavioral diagnosis without external teachers, yielding consistent benchmark gains and transferable data quality.

pa:2610.15915.name: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
pa:2610.15915.desc: ViewCraft jointly improves an evidence interface and reading procedure to boost multimodal agent performance across benchmarks without weight updates.

pa:2610.16577.name: CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction
pa:2610.16577.desc: CineRecon evaluates agents on reconstructing editable dynamic 3D scenes from videos across proxy, simplified, and detailed settings, revealing persistent failures in camera, static, and dynamic consistency.

pa:2610.18010.name: Fish Audio Drama 3 Technical Report
pa:2610.18010.desc: Fish Audio Drama 3 is an open-source 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts speech generation model that produces directed, multi-character performances with voice cloning, multi-turn revision, infilling, and streaming, using a hybrid linear-attention backbone and a multi-token-prediction decoder trained via three-stage pre-training, instruction fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning from human prefere

pa:2610.18872.name: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
pa:2610.18872.desc: EgoExplorer is a wearable vision-motion-touch dataset of human loco-manipulation that uses a calibration and completion pipeline to reconstruct whole-body motion, finger articulation, and tactile data from sparse sensors.

pa:2610.18484.name: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
pa:2610.18484.desc: ReTerm trains terminal agents to recover from execution errors via supervised fine-tuning on recovery demonstrations and online reinforcement learning from self-generated failure attempts, substantially improving task success rates.

pa:2610.18272.name: JevGPT: Thinking Fast and Slow in Autonomous Research
pa:2610.18272.desc: JevGPT couples rapid evidence assessment with deliberative planning to improve autonomous research coverage and efficiency within limited budgets.

pa:2610.17656.name: Open-o3-Video-v2: Seek, Ground, and Reason with Verifiable Spatio-Temporal Evidence
pa:2610.17656.desc: Open-o3-Video-v2 treats video reasoning as an agentic process that actively retrieves visual evidence, grounds objects and timestamps, and writes verifiable traces into its reasoning trajectory, achieving substantial gains on reasoning and grounding benchmarks.

pa:2610.14293.name: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
pa:2610.14293.desc: GeoFix improves geometric consistency and visual quality in 4D video generation by using a calibrated cross-view depth consistency reward that avoids degrading textures or penalizing motion.

pa:2610.16118.name: Elephant in the Fridge: Constant-Memory Frame Packing for Long Video Understanding
pa:2610.16118.desc: FramePack-U is a training-free method that compresses long videos into fixed-size visual representations for vision-language models by selecting diverse, prompt-relevant frames and packing them at varying resolutions, improving accuracy and reducing memory costs.
pa:2610.16118.org: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

pa:2610.18092.name: LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity
pa:2610.18092.desc: LifeSearch is a benchmark of 203 real-world life and productivity tasks that reveals deep research agents still fall short of human-level performance.

pa:2610.14766.name: Last Secure Code Benchmark: Is the Code You Vibe Secure?
pa:2610.14766.desc: The Last Secure Code Benchmark reveals that frontier AI coding agents generate functional but rarely secure code across diverse languages and vulnerability classes.

pa:2609.38377.name: PhyProbe: Rethinking Physical Consistency Evaluation in Generated Videos
pa:2609.38377.desc: PhyProbe evaluates video physical consistency by mapping frozen spatio-temporal features to calibrated violation scores via a unified ranking, regression, and calibration objective.

pa:2602.05758.name: LongR: Unleashing Long-Context Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Dense Utility Rewards
pa:2602.05758.desc: LongR improves long-context reasoning by combining interleaved document consultation with a contextual density reward, achieving substantial gains across benchmarks and reinforcement learning algorithms.

pa:2610.14228.name: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
pa:2610.14228.desc: Shifting GUI world modeling from pixel reconstruction to latent action-conditioned predictions improves efficiency and avoids identity shortcuts via contrastive learning.

pa:2610.18206.name: SWE-MISBEHAVIOR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Boundary Violations in Software Coding Agents
pa:2610.18206.desc: We present SWE-MISBEHAVIOR, the first taxonomy and evaluation framework for diagnosing boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents. It contains 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized samples spanning three layers of agent action space: (i) Code Generation, (ii) File Management, and (iii) System Interaction. Across these categories, SWE-MISBEHAVIOR covers 11 distinct misbehaviors with a fully auto

pa:2610.14351.name: Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos
pa:2610.14351.desc: WATCH improves transferable robot action and video prediction by pre-training on cross-video human demonstration pairs rather than within-video frames, boosting in-context success on unseen levels.

pa:2610.08432.name: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
pa:2610.08432.desc: EMHO is a self-evolving framework that improves embodied agent harnesses directly from experience traces by revising monitoring, tool use, and failure responses while keeping the underlying model frozen.

pa:2610.18846.name: WorldRecon: Generative Multi-View Mesh Reconstruction for Large-Scale 3D World
pa:2610.18846.desc: WorldRecon is a generative framework that reconstructs complete large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed images by using imperfect global point clouds as scaffolds, block-wise generation with reconstruction conditioning, and neighbor-aware inpainting for coherence.

pa:2610.14163.name: AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents
pa:2610.14163.desc: AutoEnvScaling automates reinforcement learning environment creation via terminal agents, enabling recursive self-improvement and reducing human design dependence.

pa:2610.15327.name: CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks
pa:2610.15327.desc: CIViC is a four-gate protocol linking interpretations to interventions and controls, revealing that visual predictors may rely on unintended audio cues across face-raster, synthetic mixture, and speaker-video tasks.

pa:2610.16533.name: Spectral-Driven Adaptive-Rank Optimizer for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
pa:2610.16533.desc: Ares adapts optimizer rank to evolving gradient spectra in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, improving reasoning accuracy across model scales and tasks.

pa:2610.15035.name: What Really Works for Universal Multimodal Embeddings? A Controlled Study of Contrastive Training Strategies
pa:2610.15035.desc: Systematic evaluation of contrastive strategies for multimodal embeddings reveals that most provide marginal gains, while combining hard-negative mining, false-negative mitigation, and hard-batch construction yields substantial improvements.

pa:2610.18766.name: Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges
pa:2610.18766.desc: ReVeR is a pointwise rubric reward model that derives criteria directly from instructions and uses tool-augmented judging to evaluate responses independently, improving preference accuracy and policy optimization.

pa:2610.15357.name: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
pa:2610.15357.desc: UniForge3D unifies 3D reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space to build complete assets from sparse images while preserving observed geometry and selecting relevant views for detail recovery.

pa:2610.14726.name: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
pa:2610.14726.desc: LightVAE accelerates video VAE decoding by separately compressing temporal and spatial components of causal Conv3D layers, using low-rank temporal corrections, folded arithmetic, depth pruning, and teacher-guided alignment to preserve quality.

pa:2610.16361.name: HexaBee-4B: Six-Language Translation with Multilingual Answering and Bidirectional Supervision
pa:2610.16361.desc: HexaBee-4B improves multilingual translation across six languages through staged training on Wikipedia, joint answering and translation, and bidirectional specialization.

pa:2610.13989.name: PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems
pa:2610.13989.desc: PsyBer-Agent is a psychology-inspired simulator using latent-state dynamics and optimal transport alignment to evaluate recommender systems over long interaction cycles.

pa:2610.15208.name: PANINI-DR: Controlled Deep Research through Generative Semantic Workspaces
pa:2610.15208.desc: PANINI-DR is a multi-agent research harness that separates investigation coordination from subquestion verification using a shared workspace, achieving state-of-the-art results on deep-research benchmarks.

pa:2610.10808.name: Controlled Acquisition and Abstention in Three-Channel Score Conflicts
pa:2610.10808.desc: The study evaluates policies for requesting a third modality or abstaining when audio, video, and text scores conflict, finding that selection value depends on budget and observed-pair ranking rather than accuracy alone.

pa:2610.15788.name: Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams
pa:2610.15788.desc: Agent Sociodrama models evolving social dynamics in LLM teams via external judgment and persona updates, and uses trajectory-guided persona recasting to repair group failures and improve collaborative performance.

pa:2610.15772.name: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
pa:2610.15772.desc: RSIPO is a self-evolving agentic reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves agentic skills and policies while calibrating teacher supervision reliability via empirical Bayes shrinkage.
pa:2610.15772.org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

pa:2610.13416.name: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
pa:2610.13416.desc: WebShell unifies web search, browser interaction, and persistent evidence storage into a single interface to improve long-horizon agent performance at lower cost.

pa:2610.00359.name: Diffusion Editing with Soft Mask: Pixel Level Redo of Image and Video with Adjustable Strength
pa:2610.00359.desc: SoftPaint enables continuous, pixel-level image and video editing via soft masks using a gradient-free Langevin-based sampler without requiring annotations.

pa:2610.18862.name: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
pa:2610.18862.desc: DoubtLess uses a small reasoning model to steer larger models toward shorter chain-of-thought outputs without training, reducing token usage while preserving accuracy.

pa:2610.12412.name: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
pa:2610.12412.desc: WorldCast is a distributed multiplayer world model that uses local clients with state exchange and shared scene observations to generate consistent, scalable real-time views for multiple players.
pa:2610.12412.org: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

pa:2610.16985.name: AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding
pa:2610.16985.desc: AUGUstus unifies diffusion-based action generation with autoregressive chain-of-thought reasoning in a vision-language-action model to achieve low-latency, explainable autonomous driving with state-of-the-art planning performance.

pa:2610.14158.name: Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability
pa:2610.14158.desc: Video-Arena evaluates visual models on evolving world-state understanding via competitive game videos across event perception, state interpretation, and tracking tasks.

pa:2610.15965.name: Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs
pa:2610.15965.desc: Repeated-data pretraining reveals that smaller batches with implicit regularization and adjusted recipes improve validation loss, while time and GPU budgets require balancing batch size against parallelism rather than maximizing utilization.

pa:2610.16601.name: MixLID: Token-Level Language Identification in Mixed-Language Text
pa:2610.16601.desc: MixLID is a token-level language identification model for 111 language-script combinations that uses two-stage training on monolingual and mixed-language data to improve accuracy in both monolingual and code-switched settings.

pa:2610.15124.name: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
pa:2610.15124.desc: Ours is an elastic transformer with block lower-triangular hidden matrices that enables joint training of nested sub-networks at fixed cost, paired with μE scaling rules that preserve maximal updates and hyperparameter transfer across sizes.

pa:2610.16135.name: Omni-Modal LLMs Know More Than They Say
pa:2610.16135.desc: Omni-LLMs often perceive non-textual data but fail to express it; a token-level alignment analysis and self-generated text strategy improve multimodal reasoning and balance modality use.

pa:2610.16172.name: EventLens: Event-Structure Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding
pa:2610.16172.desc: EventLens improves video temporal reasoning by training multimodal models to recover event structure via reinforcement learning with deterministic rewards and multi-teacher distillation.

pa:2610.18025.name: SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces
pa:2610.18025.desc: SHELDON separates hypothesis and observation exploration to discover unexplained evidence and generate novel scientific reasoning solutions.

pa:2610.17625.name: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
pa:2610.17625.desc: 4LC introduces a reusable 4D latent cache that combines multi-encoder visual representations with geometry and motion to efficiently condition video generation across time and viewpoints.

pa:2610.17540.name: TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency
pa:2610.17540.desc: TacitVLA improves vision-language-action models by decoupling reasoning supervision from action generation, reducing latency while maintaining or improving task success across manipulation and driving benchmarks.

pa:2610.14912.name: Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents
pa:2610.14912.desc: Generative and decision language models were evaluated as synthetic survey respondents, with generative models generally outperforming decision models in reproducing item correlations and sample-level patterns, though neither fully matched real respondent fidelity.

pa:2610.04851.name: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
pa:2610.04851.desc: CURIO enhances open-ended discovery by combining reinforcement learning with an intrinsic curiosity world model that rewards exploration beyond high-reward paths, improving mathematical and biological task performance across model scales.

pa:2610.18352.name: Let the Mind Conceive, Let the Hand Achieve: Following Multimodal Instructions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
pa:2610.18352.desc: Orchestra separates planning and execution management from action generation to enable robots to follow multi-step instructions, track progress, and adapt to changing scenes, achieving longer successful subtask sequences than prior methods.

pa:2609.37377.name: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation
pa:2609.37377.desc: On-policy distillation effectiveness depends on the teacher-student relationship and target task rather than prompt quantity alone, with random sampling often matching targeted selection.

sp:Qwen/Qwen3-TTS.name: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS
sp:Qwen/Qwen3-TTS.zh: 阿里 Qwen 團隊的全新語音合成模型
sp:Qwen/Qwen3-TTS.why: 擴展 Qwen 家族至語音領域，補齊多模態生態的聽覺輸出拼圖

pa:2610.19605.name: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
pa:2610.19605.desc: PN-Mix improves low-bit KV cache quantization by identifying salient RoPE channel pairs via query-key norms, achieving strong accuracy at lower bit rates.

pa:2610.20818.name: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
pa:2610.20818.desc: Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that uses multi-codebook discrete visual tokens to unify image, video, and 3D generation with text in a single backbone, achieving high performance and faster inference.

pa:2610.21359.name: SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes
pa:2610.21359.desc: SWE-at-Scale synthesizes realistic software engineering tasks by inverting real-world fixes to generate diverse, executable bugs for evaluating coding agents.

pa:2610.20828.name: CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
pa:2610.20828.desc: CoTranslator translates reverse reasoning traces to match verified forward reasoning distributions, enabling efficient and transferable reasoning distillation for student models.

pa:2610.20556.name: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
pa:2610.20556.desc: Speculative Sampling enables interactive video generation with large bidirectional windows by caching predictions and delivering them incrementally, reducing latency without sacrificing quality.
pa:2610.20556.org: university of science and technology  of china

pa:2610.17191.name: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
pa:2610.17191.desc: FreeSolo introduces a native sparse attention mechanism with short-range and long-range branches that achieves linear-time complexity and improves zero-shot length extrapolation without costly long-context fine-tuning.

pa:2610.19121.name: Unlocking Structured Pruning for Reasoning Language Models via Attention-Preserving MLP Trimming
pa:2610.19121.desc: LayerTrim is a training-free structured pruning approach that removes redundant decoder layers and trims MLP features to preserve reasoning ability, reducing inference costs and generation length.

pa:2610.20526.name: Lluna: Collaborative Unimodal Models for Missing-Modality Inference
pa:2610.20526.desc: Lluna improves multimodal predictions under missing inputs by combining private unimodal predictions with graph-based residual collaboration and progressive consistency training.

gh:LibreSpark/LibreTV.name: LibreSpark/LibreTV
gh:LibreSpark/LibreTV.desc: 一分钟搭建影视站，支持Docker等部署方式
gh:LibreSpark/LibreTV.zh: 一分鐘快速搭建影視站的開源部署工具

pa:2610.20939.name: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
pa:2610.20939.desc: MAI-Gym is an open platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online reinforcement learning training across mobile, computer, and web environments, enabling scalable synthesis of verified tasks and training of a unified 9B agent with state-of-the-art open performance.

pa:2610.19397.name: SERO: Learning from Executable Oracle Continuations for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.19397.desc: SERO improves long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning by training on executable oracle continuations from real policy states, weighted by policy compatibility, without inference-time overhead.

pa:2610.06598.name: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
pa:2610.06598.desc: SimForcing improves action-conditioned robot world models by distilling motion knowledge from simulation and using controllable simulation conditioning to generate realistic videos across robot datasets.

pa:2610.21910.name: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
pa:2610.21910.desc: CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that uses a video world model as a flexible visual reasoning engine, enabling vision-language models to perform diverse spatiotemporal reasoning through guided visual imagination and co-evolving tools.

pa:2610.22200.name: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
pa:2610.22200.desc: OpenGCUA introduces an open generalist computer-use agent that integrates visual and programmatic interfaces, harness-to-model decision transfer, and code execution to improve task performance and efficiency across models.

pa:2610.22362.name: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
pa:2610.22362.desc: CoDA co-evolves a simulation engine and robot policy via shared memory of failures and progress, using vision-language diagnostics and staged potential rewards to improve out-of-distribution manipulation success.

pa:2610.22276.name: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
pa:2610.22276.desc: MJev-Spatial is a fast multimodal decision model that unifies spatial reasoning tasks into a single-pass classification framework, improving speed and accuracy over autoregressive vision-language models.

pa:2610.21306.name: VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2610.21306.desc: VLA-Δ improves robot control by explicitly supervising physical state transitions between current and future observations, achieving strong benchmark and real-world results without added inference cost.

pa:2610.17670.name: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
pa:2610.17670.desc: Cowork-Gym synthesizes collaborative agent environments via iterative validation and trains Qwen models that substantially improve agentic benchmark performance.

pa:2610.18125.name: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
pa:2610.18125.desc: H-DDCM replaces dense Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries and table-free lexicographic coding to enable scalable, efficient generative image and video compression using diffusion and flow models.

pa:2610.18890.name: AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization
pa:2610.18890.desc: An AI-driven framework uses learned ranking and deterministic EDA analysis to recover post-route power while controlling repair costs and preserving timing, electrical, and physical constraints.

pa:2610.21601.name: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
pa:2610.21601.desc: Waypoint-OPD improves policy-shift distillation by gating endpoint shifts using directional agreement between early and late teacher policy changes, boosting reasoning performance with minimal overhead.
pa:2610.21601.zh: 提升AI推理效能的全新知識傳授方法
pa:2610.21601.why: 透過優化學習過程中的引導方式，讓AI用更少資源學會更聰明的推理能力

pa:2610.22240.name: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
pa:2610.22240.desc: MMSearch-OPD improves long-horizon multimodal search by refining reasoning data and jointly training with reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation.

pa:2610.22344.name: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
pa:2610.22344.desc: A post-training framework using hierarchical supervised fine-tuning and windowed interaction reinforcement learning trains a 35B mixture-of-experts agent to autonomously optimize long-horizon machine learning engineering workflows.

pa:2610.16355.name: PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation
pa:2610.16355.desc: PINT unifies vision-language reasoning, video world modeling, and action generation via learnable predictive intent tokens to improve robot manipulation generalization without embodied pretraining.

pa:2610.21439.name: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
pa:2610.21439.desc: MRTPO improves multi-reward training by assigning each reward's advantage only to relevant tokens via replay-based relevance measurement, accelerating convergence and boosting performance.
pa:2610.21439.org: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

pa:2610.22322.name: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
pa:2610.22322.desc: Market-based post-training jointly learns decentralized agent policies and self-orchestration via bidding, improving coordination, scalability, and robustness across embodied and research tasks.

pa:2610.16397.name: Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2610.16397.desc: Recursive Environment Scaling transforms benchmarks to increase difficulty while preserving objectives, improving both agent evaluation and supervised fine-tuning performance.

pa:2610.20731.name: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
pa:2610.20731.desc: Researchers propose a four-level hierarchy for multimodal generative models and introduce the WorldCast benchmark to evaluate multi-step world state prediction, revealing rapid progress by frontier systems but substantial gaps in open-source models for reasoning-heavy visual forecasting.

pa:2610.22174.name: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.22174.desc: Multi-session agentic reinforcement learning is introduced to handle trajectories across multiple sessions, with Mosaic optimizing session-level contributions and allocation via hierarchical advantage estimation.

pa:2610.20509.name: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
pa:2610.20509.desc: VascuSR is an iterative diffusion framework that integrates 3D vascular guidance with super-resolution to improve anatomical accuracy and vascular connectivity in CT reconstructions.

pa:2610.18813.name: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
pa:2610.18813.desc: A framework for self-evolving agent harnesses uses feedback-driven revisions and evolutionary optimization with theoretical generalization guarantees while keeping model weights fixed.
pa:2610.18813.zh: 能在不改動模型參數下自我進化的AI系統
pa:2610.18813.why: 讓AI助理透過回饋與演化機制持續變聰明，不需要重新訓練模型就能自我升級

pa:2610.21453.name: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
pa:2610.21453.desc: CarryOn enhances frozen vision-language-action policies with persistent personalized planning and supervised execution with recovery skills to improve safety and adaptability.

pa:2610.17665.name: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
pa:2610.17665.desc: Vision-language models struggle to convert 2D visual observations into precise 3D rotational control, showing large gaps versus humans in projection alignment tasks.

pa:2610.21463.name: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
pa:2610.21463.desc: SpecAgent improves agent efficiency by having a small model draft tool-use steps that a large model verifies in parallel, reducing latency and memory use while preserving quality.

pa:2610.19063.name: WorldMemBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Memory of Video World Models
pa:2610.19063.desc: WorldMemBench evaluates world memory in video models by testing static and dynamic retention across repeated revisits and state transitions.

pa:2610.22186.name: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
pa:2610.22186.desc: EVA-Cap improves audiovisual video captioning by decomposing captions into atomic events and optimizing event-centric alignment through supervised fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization.

pa:2610.20341.name: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
pa:2610.20341.desc: InfiniSplat v2 improves feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction by decoupling geometry and attribute prediction, aligning Gaussians with ground-truth poses, and using large-angle supervision to enhance novel-view rendering quality.

pa:2610.22217.name: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
pa:2610.22217.desc: SCOPED trains separate experts for distinct capabilities, extracts skills via reward-guided reflection, and distills procedural knowledge into a unified vision-language model without exposing explicit skills at inference, reducing cross-capability interference.

pa:2610.20603.name: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
pa:2610.20603.desc: CommerceGen-Studio is a three-stage framework that generates commercial e-commerce product images by combining iterative metadata distillation, layout optimization, and a specialized diffusion model to maintain subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and text accuracy at production scale.

pa:2610.06829.name: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
pa:2610.06829.desc: CLIFT uses conformal self-verification to convert sparse judge feedback into reusable training rewards and judge-free test-time trajectory selection for open-source web agents.

pa:2610.19849.name: DeltaStreamer: Towards Human-Like Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
pa:2610.19849.desc: DeltaStreamer is an agentic framework for streaming video understanding that uses change-aware memory and query-driven replay to preserve event dynamics and recover missing visual evidence for accurate answers.

pa:2610.22282.name: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.22282.desc: Routing Policy Optimization introduces stochastic attention routing inside diffusion generators to align them with reward signals while preserving the original deterministic sampler and improving training efficiency.

pa:2610.22311.name: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
pa:2610.22311.desc: Velox accelerates long video rollouts by routing attention via geometric frustum slabs, reducing latency while preserving visual coherence.

pa:2610.14993.name: Learning Where to Split: Dynamic Band Splitting for Audio Source Separation
pa:2610.14993.desc: Dynamic Band Splitting adapts frequency partition boundaries to each audio mixture, improving source separation quality while maintaining a fixed token budget.

pa:2610.16784.name: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
pa:2610.16784.desc: InfoVis is a unified 9B model for slide generation and editing trained on millions of native records and evaluated on a new multidimensional benchmark, achieving top open-source performance across text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, design, and editing.

pa:2610.15368.name: ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs
pa:2610.15368.desc: ANTE is a reinforcement learning framework that uses pre-action predictions verified by execution to provide per-step credit and improve coding agent decisions, significantly boosting benchmark performance.

pa:2610.20111.name: RepForcing: Representation-Space Initialization for Autoregressive Video Distillation
pa:2610.20111.desc: Representation Forcing improves few-step video generation by using feature-space supervision instead of trajectory regression, boosting quality metrics over causal ODE baselines.

pa:2610.22070.name: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
pa:2610.22070.desc: MaLoW internalizes streaming video history into evolving LoRA weights via a recurrent HyperNetwork, improving streaming vision-language performance with minimal latency overhead.

pa:2610.22319.name: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
pa:2610.22319.desc: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic.
